refero:6310.summary: From an empty Upcoming schedule, add a class from a catalog service, set start and weekly days, Create, and see series cards with capacity and a publish pop-up.
steps: Add a Class panel: service and start
Weekly with Mon to Sun day labels
Pop-up: Power Yoga is now live
steal: Picking a catalog service fills duration and location into a summary card, so only start time and repeat are left before Create (screens 2 to 4).
Repeat presets (Does not repeat, Weekly, Every 2 to 4 weeks) then Mon to Sun day labels expand only when Weekly is on (screens 5 to 6).
A live sentence summary ('…from 10:00 to 10:45, starting on Jul 5') confirms end time without a separate end field (screens 2 and 6).
After create, the pop-up 'Power Yoga is now live! Clients can now book…' marks publish, not just save (screen 7).
avoid: An agenda list alone has no week or room grid, so room or faculty double-booking cannot be spotted while creating.
refero:6310.fit: Scheduling: cheap simple-event path. Scenario as catalog service, default duration and room, then weekly day labels for N sessions. Extends baseline simple events, not flexi cell assignment.

refero:6311.summary: Open a class from Upcoming, Cancel booking, choose this occurrence versus all future classes, then see a Canceled label kept on the list with a success pop-up.
steps: Scope: this class or all future
steal: The scope dialog offers 'Cancel only this class' (primary red) versus 'Cancel all future classes - on at 15:00', and says booked clients can rebook (screen 3).
The occurrence stays on the agenda with a red 'Canceled' label (and struck time) instead of vanishing, so schedule history remains visible (screens 4 to 5).
Booking details splits Clients into Attending and Cancelled tabs before the cancel action (screen 2).
avoid: There is no on-screen confirmation that invitees were notified, only organizer-side cancel. Do not assume attendee email behaviour from this flow.
refero:6311.fit: Scheduling: reuse for session-series cancel scope (one run versus rest of rotation) with a cancel-in-place label for coordinators. Comparable to Amie/Motion this/all, but framed as organizer cancel.
